original.target_description: Experiment 4b color-triplet recognition against chance; real-triplet trials only

replication.target_description: Final replication primary project table: original Study 4b; whether visual statistical learning could be feature-based over colors of objects; expects an above-chance recall rate in the test phase of the experiment for trials containing real triplets from the familiarization phase. A t-test of the recall rate should be significantly different from 0 (as in the original experiment)
